children: on March 31, 2027, after more than 26 years with the company and Unity Bank.
Hughes will remain on the boards of both companies after stepping down.
The current president, George Boyan, will become CEO of Unity Bancorp and Unity Bank on April 1, 2027. Boyan has served as president since January 2026 and has held several leadership roles at Unity.
During Hughes’ tenure, the company grew total assets from about $356M to $3.2B, and book value per share also increased more than 8.5x.
